checks.message: Provisional boundary (PROV-SITE-001) is present with official_boundary=false and geometry_role=provisional_constraint; replace with official redline before statutory use.

Metrics are consistent with geometry declarations and proposal narrative; unknown metrics (floor_area_ratio) carry explicit reasons and preconditions.
Compliance matrix covers announcement 1.3/1.4/1.5 and agent.1-agent.6 with status, evidence_files and notes for every requirement.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions.
